file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of modular views structure
file_insights.content_scope: Detailed guide covering 5 modules (dashboard, purchase_requests, purchase_orders, receiving, api) with 25 total views
file_insights.documentation_quality: High - includes overview, module breakdown, statistics, workflow diagram, patterns, benefits, and migration notes

patterns_discovered.description: Monolithic 1084-line views.py refactored into 5 specialized modules organized by business domain
Views organized by functional domains: solicitações (requests), pedidos (orders), recebimento (receiving), API endpoints
Clear workflow diagram showing 3-stage process: DRAFT → PENDING/SENT → APPROVED/CONFIRMED → RECEIVED
patterns_discovered.stages: Request submission, Order creation and confirmation, Material receiving and inventory update

patterns_discovered.description: Consistent patterns across modules: list, detail, create, update operations with status workflow management

gotchas_discovered.description: Refactoring 1084 lines from single file required careful separation while maintaining URL compatibility and import paths
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documented in __init__.py exports and urls.py mapping

gotchas_discovered.description: README contains static statistics (line counts, view counts) that require updates if modules change
gotchas_discovered.risk: Documentation becoming outdated as code evolves

gotchas_discovered.description: Documentation written entirely in Portuguese which may limit accessibility for international teams
gotchas_discovered.consideration: Localization strategy needed if project expands globally

approach_outcome.deliverable: Comprehensive README.md documenting new modular structure
approach_outcome.scope_coverage: Complete documentation of all 25 views across 5 modules with workflow, patterns, and benefits
approach_outcome.validation: System checks passed, original views.py validated and removed after migration

recommendations.recommendation: Create a script or CI check to validate that README statistics (line counts, view counts) remain accurate as code evolves
Consider adding type hints and docstrings to individual view functions to enhance IDE navigation and discoverability
Prepare English version of README for international team collaboration while maintaining Portuguese original
As noted in 'Próximos Passos', prepare for new modules (reports.py) and service layer separation following DDD principles
Document and enforce use of __init__.py exports to maintain clean imports and prevent circular dependencies
